symptoms: duplicate captures matching gateway timeout retries
causal_chain: Idempotency key enforcement disabled (gateway config off)
Gateway experiences a timeout on a capture attempt
Gateway automatically retries the capture without sending an idempotency key
PSP processes the retry as a new capture (no deduplication)
Order ends with two captures → double charge
Customer observes double charge and files a support ticket
